name: What causes water to leak under a sink?

mainEntity.name: What causes water to leak under a sink?

acceptedAnswer.text: Water leaks under a sink can stem from several common issues. Loose connections in the plumbing lines, a worn-out P-trap seal, or a corroded drain pipe are frequent culprits. Faulty faucet components, such as a dripping cartridge or O-rings, can also allow water to escape. Additionally, a damaged garbage disposal or issues with the dishwasher connection can contribute to leaks. Identifying the exact source is crucial for effective repair and preventing further water damage.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common causes include loose plumbing connections, worn P-trap seals, corroded drain pipes, faulty faucet components, or issues with a garbage disposal.
